description.value: Mowich is a hike-in backcountry campground in E.C. Manning Park, set in the Cascade Mountains more than 1 km from any road; a permit ($5/person/night) is required but no advance reservation, making it a solid wilderness night with real commitment to reach.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm this is a BC Parks backcountry tent campsite (backcountry=yes, tents=yes, operator=BC Parks, tourism=camp_site). The website confirms Mowich is one of multiple named backcountry campgrounds in E.C. Manning Park, all located more than 1 km from any highway or park road, and requires a permit but NOT a reservation — the site explicitly names only Buckhorn, Kicking Horse, and Frosty Creek as the three requiring reservations, omitting Mowich. No Mowich-specific facility details (water, shelter, food storage, etc.) are provided on the website beyond the general permit requirement shared by all campgrounds in the park.
concerns: Backcountry location is defined as more than 1 km from any highway or park road — bicycle accessibility is unconfirmed and may require hiking-in.
